glosses: at the same time as; the moment (that)
while also being; and at once
patterns.usage_note: Two readings share the form: temporal simultaneity after a verb (ドアが閉まると同時に, the instant the doors shut) and dual identity after である or an い-adjective (医師であると同時に母, a doctor and a mother at once). A bare event noun attaches directly (卒業と同時に); である is only needed for the dual-identity reading. It is more formal than とすぐに, and unlike かと思うと it carries no surprise: the second event is simply concurrent, and it may perfectly well be planned or deliberate.

examples.ruby: ドアが閉[し]まると同時[どうじ]に、電車[でんしゃ]はゆっくり動[うご]き出[だ]した。
examples.english: The moment the doors shut, the train began to pull away.

examples.ruby: 叔母[おば]は外科医[げかい]であると同時[どうじ]に、二人[ふたり]の母[はは]でもある。
examples.english: My aunt is a surgeon and, at the same time, a mother of two.

examples.ruby: 大会[たいかい]が開幕[かいまく]すると同時[どうじ]に、街[まち]の空気[くうき]が変[か]わった。
examples.english: The instant the tournament opened, the whole mood of the town changed.
